units.source_text: 名人在东京把白发染黑了才来的。

en.t: The Meijin had dyed his white hair black in Tokyo before coming.

units.source_text: 染黑了白发才出战，似乎和名人不太相称。

en.t: Going into the match only after dyeing his white hair black seemed rather unbecoming of the Meijin.

units.source_text: 名人在对局中途病倒之后，也想这样打扮一番吧。

en.t: Even after falling ill in the middle of the match, the Meijin must have wanted to make himself presentable in that way.
